name: Cashfeed
description: Cashfeed is finance-operations software for businesses: it captures purchase and sales invoices, suppliers and bank transactions, routes approvals, and books everything into your accounting software automatically. The connector lets Claude read your invoices, suppliers, transactions and spend, surface what needs approval, and — always with your confirmation — update invoices, suppliers and approvals. All data is scoped per organisation and respects the signed-in user's permissions, exactly like the Cashfeed web app.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cashfeed to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cashfeed to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.app.cashfeed.com/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cashfeed MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cashfeed lists 34 MCP tools, including cashfeed_api_get_operation_schema, cashfeed_api_invoke, cashfeed_api_list_operations, cashfeed_api_list_tags, cashfeed_approve_invoices, cashfeed_get_active_connections, cashfeed_get_analytic_accounts, cashfeed_get_invoice, cashfeed_get_invoice_aggregates, cashfeed_get_invoice_cycle_time_stats, cashfeed_get_invoice_status_breakdown, and cashfeed_get_invoices.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cashfeed?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cashfeed in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Cashfeed requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cashfeed is developed by Cashfeed. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
